cases.issue:
Sales report shows the wrong median order value

When there is an even number of orders the sales report prints the wrong median. With four orders worth 10, 20, 30 and 40 dollars, `shopkit report` prints `Median order value: 30.00`, but the median of those orders is 25.00 (the mean of the two middle values). With an odd number of orders it looks right.

Checkout charges almost no sales tax

A $200.00 cart shipped to California should get 7.25% sales tax ($14.50) for a receipt total of $214.50 (shipping is free over $75). The receipt instead shows tax 0.15 and total 200.15. The tax report (`tax_liability`) shows correct numbers for the same orders, so the rates themselves seem fine.

App crashes sometimes

shopkit crashes sometimes when I load my orders. It worked last week. Please fix ASAP!!

cases.issue:
Product URLs lose their model numbers

`Catalog.url_for` builds URLs like `/products/product-pro-p2` for a product named "Product 2 Pro" -- the 2 disappears from the slug. `slugify("Product 2 Pro")` returns `product-pro`; expected `product-2-pro`. Punctuation should still be stripped.
